transcript: Here's how to overcome fear in just a few seconds by exposing it, not calming it, not breathing through it, but by exposing it. The moment fear shows up, ask yourself, if I do this, what's the worst that will actually happen? Will you die? No. Will people laugh at you? Maybe. For five seconds, and then they go back to their own life. Will you fail? Maybe. And then what? You try again. Fear survives because you never challenge it. It hides in the dark corners of your mind whispering, don't try, don't risk, don't grow. So shine a light on it. Ask, why am I scared of this? What am I really protecting? And if the worst happened, then what? Most of the time you'll notice something funny. Your fear has no teeth. It's just a story. A tiny thought pretending to be a monster. So laugh at it. Seriously, laugh. Laugh at the self-doubt. This journey is for you. The link is in my bio. Join us and begin your 30-day healing experience. Your peace begins the moment you enter.
